description: The agent must: (1) Read business/metrics_q1.csv and identify 'delivery capacity' as the bottleneck (NOT lead gen or conversion — leads are plentiful and close rate is fine, but 70+ hrs/week worked and projects declined due to capacity). (2) Apply the SKILL.md automation ROI rule (>=15 min AND >=10x/month) to ops/task_logs/recurring_tasks.csv: correctly flag thumbnail_creation (25min, 15x), send_invoice (20min, 15x), and upload_and_tag_video (18min, 15x) for automation; correctly exclude client_strategy_call_prep (30min but only 6x/month — fails frequency test) and reply_to_client_slack (10min, 40x — fails time test). (3) Read ops/task_logs/hiring_consideration.txt: 45 hrs/month of editing = ~11 hrs/week, which is BELOW the SKILL.md's 30hrs/week employee threshold — must recommend CONTRACTOR, not employee. (4) Produce an SOP for thumbnail creation using the EXACT SKILL.md template structure: sections labeled TASK:, OWNER:, FREQUENCY:, TOOLS NEEDED:, STEPS:, COMMON ISSUES AND SOLUTIONS:, CHECKLIST: — with Issue:/Solution: sub-format under common issues and '- [ ]' checkbox format in checklist. (5) Reference the 'double revenue before doubling team' principle and the 20-30% per quarter sustainable growth guideline from SKILL.md Step 7 and Step 9.
